item_short_desc: Sabre Campus Safety Pepper Gel offers maximum stopping power with its gel formula. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: Sabre Campus Safety Pepper Gel offers maximum stopping power with its gel formula. Complete with a pink hard case and quick release key ring for hands-free carry, the Sabre Pepper Gel is safe to use indoors, reduces wind blowback and has no effect on bystanders. With a range of 10 feet and containing approximately 25 shots, this is the ideal personal protection item. Made in the USA.
